officialSources.observation: Official Buldhana district administration page lists Maharashtra e-revenue services and links e-Nakasha (Mahabhunakasha) for viewing land maps, plus e-Bhulekh and property-card services. This is district/state service evidence, not a verified Khamgaon response.
Official Maharashtra Bhumi Abhilekh portal describes government land-record services and Mahabhunakasha maps with land records.

Official BhuNaksha viewer is indexed with State, Category, District, Taluka, Village, plot-number search, plot information, layers, and map controls; the live page did not return within the bounded request.
Official Marathi land-record page describes digitized survey maps and parcel information including survey/gat number, area, and coordinates; it does not itself expose a Khamgaon parcel response.

requests.outcome: Bounded curl request timed out after 30 seconds before headers/body were returned; no JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, or geometry was obtained. No login or bypass was attempted.
Search-indexed official viewer description showed location selectors, plot-number search, plot info, layers, and map controls, but not a live anonymous response or endpoint configuration.
Official Buldhana page opened and its e-Nakasha link was observed; page inspection supplied service links only, not Khamgaon parcel geometry.
Official property-card service was identified and described district/taluka/property-card selectors, but no safe parcel polygon response was obtained or requested.

registryBasis: State and district first-party portals document land-map and land-record services, but no Khamgaon-local registry/cadastre response or city-specific public map service was verified in this attempt.
